title: Team Fortress 2
provenance: reported by hayden9002 (highball-db#11), Apple M5 Pro, several sessions, unverified by Highball
notes: Plays. Reported on an M5 Pro over several sessions: on the built-in ProMotion display with Highball's frame rate limit at 120, DXMT, raw input on, it plays perfectly. On an external 60 Hz monitor the game's own "Wait for vertical sync" held the frame rate at 59.95; turning it off frees the frame rate, but the view still stutters while the mouse moves (smooth when walking, jitter only from camera movement), on DXMT uncapped and on DXVK alike; DXVK with Highball's limit at 60 and the game's at 120 is mainly playable with noticeable camera jitter. Kayf-Life shows the same; Portal 2 on the same monitor does not. Not tried here.

anticheat.note: VAC is userspace and runs under Wine; Counter-Strike 2 plays online under it here

knownIssues.symptom: On an external 60 Hz monitor the view jitters while the mouse moves (walking is smooth, only camera movement stutters), with raw input on, on DXMT and DXVK alike; the built-in ProMotion display with a 120 fps limit plays perfectly (M5 Pro).
knownIssues.cause: Not investigated here yet. The game's own vertical sync was one part (it capped the frame rate at 59.95; off, the cap is gone) and is ruled out as the cause of the mouse jitter. Portal 2 on the same monitor is fine, so the remaining part is specific to this game's mouse handling under Wine on a 60 Hz display.
knownIssues.fix: Reported to work: the built-in display with Highball's frame rate limit at 120, raw input on. On a 60 Hz monitor: turn off "Wait for vertical sync" in the game's advanced video options (frees the frame rate), then DXVK with Highball's limit at 60 and the game's at 120 is mainly playable. The remaining camera jitter is open.
